Sasha Miller: Hey all! Sasha here — starting today in Eng-Platform. I bake sourdough on Sundays and play slightly off-key guitar covers. Hi! :wave:
Tom Brooks: welcome Sasha! :tada: where's your desk?
Sasha Miller: I'll be at 3C (near the green couch). happy to trade starter for coffee.
Eli Tran: starter trade accepted. also, welcome! are you team morning or team night for standups?
Sasha Miller: team morning — PST. 9am standup works for me.
Zara Koh: Yesss sourdough! Bring samples to the kitchen round at 3pm? :bread:
Mina Alvarez: welcome! FYI badge pickup with HR is at 2pm, sign up here: https://intra.redwood/corp/badges
Welcome Bot: Welcome to Redwood, Sasha! Onboarding checklist: https://intra.redwood/onboarding/sasha (reminder set for 5pm)
Tom Brooks: small poll — acoustic set at Friday rooftop? react with :guitar: if yes
Eli Tran: :guitar:
Mina Alvarez: :guitar: + :baguette:
Sasha Miller: I'll bring a tiny amp and croissants? (just kidding on amp) Can't wait to meet everyone :)
